request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), how often must the DEFRIES-TITANO overhead travelling crane at position 11 be verified?

response.text: {"kind": "duration", "value": "P1Y", "text": "The DEFRIES-TITANO overhead travelling crane (position 11, GRU A PONTE SCORREVOLE, built 1978, Masua-Acquaresi, Iglesias, an 'Area mineraria') must be verified annually. Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/2008, row 15, sets annual checks for fixed lifting appliances over 200 kg used in extractive sectors that were built more than 10 years ago. The files do not state outright that an overhead travelling crane is 'fisso'; I took that from its listing in the plant records as a non-mobile crane.", "sources": [{"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 15", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 6, Allegato A, Tabella A2", "quote": "GRU A PONTE DEFRIES - 11 3000 CA 194 / 85 1978 11222 SCORREVOLE TITANO"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 8, Allegato B, Tabella B1", "quote": "GRU A PONTE DEFRIES - 11 3000 CA 194 / 85 1978 11222 Iglesias Acquaresi SCORREVOLE TITANO"}, {"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3, section 2.2", "quote": "Area mineraria Monteponi 19 Iglesias Campo Pisano Masua - Acquaresi 2 Gadoni Miniera Funtana Raminosa 2 Lula Miniera Sos Enattos 1 Furtei Miniera Furtei"}]}
